hints.content:
The double number lines show that we need $\blueE{2\dfrac12}$ bananas for $\maroonD1$ loaf of banana bread.


Number of loaves | Number of bananas 
:-: | :-:
$1$ | $2\dfrac12$

The remaining values in the table represent ratios that are equivalent to this ratio.

If we use $2$ times as many bananas, we will make  $2$ times as many loaves.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A double number line with 3 unequally spaced tick marks. The values in the second number line, labeled Bananas, are 2 and 1 half times the corresponding values in the first number line, labeled Loaves. The line labeled Loaves, reads from left to right: 0, 1, 2. The line labeled Bananas, reads from left to right: 0, 2 and 1 half, 5. An arrow from the pair 1 to 2 and 1 half to the pair 2 to 5 is labeled times 2.

hints.content:

An arrow from the pair 1 to 2 and 1 half to the pair 4 to 10 is labeled times 4.
